record_title: A sharp ordinary-modulus median bound for two-summand expansive decompositions
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The general m^{-1/2} bound is not claimed sharp for every admissible (d,m,k); the exact two-summand median constant in M_4 is not determined; and no infinite-dimensional essential-spectrum analogue is proved. Older matrix-inequality or singular-value literature using different terminology is the principal residual prior-art risk.
